subject.title: [v2026.3.24] Two regressions: browser tabs CLI syntax break + gateway cycling after doctor --fix

question: Should OpenClaw support an explicit daemon runtime pin or acknowledgement path for version-manager Node services, or keep supported system Node as the only doctor-repair target?
rationale: The remaining report is not a narrow code defect anymore: exact runtime pinning would add supported daemon CLI/env behavior, while warning-only suppression would contradict current runtime best-practice diagnostics.

options.title: Sponsor Runtime Pinning
options.body: Refresh and prove the runtime-path PR, preserve current safeguards, and accept the new daemon pin as supported API.

options.title: Keep System Node Policy
options.body: Document that system Node is the only supported repair target and improve doctor guidance for broken version-manager units without adding a pin contract.

options.title: Split Narrow Diagnostics
options.body: Leave runtime policy to the canonical issue and only add diagnostics that make failed systemd restarts actionable for users.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Runtime Pinning
recommendation.body: Refresh and prove the runtime-path PR, preserve current safeguards, and accept the new daemon pin as supported API.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest shared history across the CLI compatibility fix and daemon runtime policy surface.
